description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/latlon3d/rules/ppm_D_lon_periodic — the Piecewise Parabolic Method (Colella-Woodward 1984) conservative finite-volume zonal derivative with explicit periodic wrap on the rank-3 latlon3d grid. Every binding loads fixture.esm (NLON=8, NLAT=5, NLEV=4 bound at the import edge), inlines the ppm_face_value / ppm_limit_right / ppm_flux / ppm_D_lon_interior / ppm_D_lon_wrap_col* body-reference templates (esm-spec 9.7.3), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: D(u,lon) replaced by the rule's rank-3 six-region makearray (interior conservative PPM flux-difference aggregate (F_{i+1/2}-F_{i-1/2})/dlon_deg over [4,6] x [1,5] x [1,4]; the five explicit periodic-wrap slab faces i=1,2,3,7,8 each over [c,c] x [1,5] x [1,4]), fired at priority 10, with zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, zero surviving metaparameter names, and the free name dlon_deg surviving. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
